title: Sanyu and the Wedding
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu attends Auntie Rose's wedding and discovers that true beauty is not what she expected.
keywords: beauty, character, wedding, family, Uganda, girls, virtue
dedication: For every girl learning that true beauty comes from the heart.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu is amazed by the beautiful bride! But when she notices something about Jjajja, she begins to wonder what real beauty means.
